title: Project: Log Analyser
story: The control room gets logs like the ones you searched in the Debug the Outage missions. Build an analyser the night shift can trust.
goal: Write analyse(log): a dict with total (non-empty lines), errors (lines starting with ERROR) and top_error (the most common error message, or None if there are no errors). Lines look like LEVEL message.

tests.label: Mixed log
tests.expr:
analyse("INFO started
ERROR disk full
WARN slow
ERROR disk full
ERROR db down
")

hints: First keep only the non-empty lines. Then collect the messages of the ERROR lines.
line.split(" ", 1)[1] is the message after the level. Counter(messages).most_common(1) finds the top one.
socratic: How do you find the most common message?
Compare your output with the goal. What differs?
explain: In one sentence: what is the key idea in “Project: Log Analyser”?
